title: Company Events Policy & Guidelines
content:
# Company Events Policy

## All-Hands Meetings

### Scheduling Requirements
- All-hands meetings must be scheduled with minimum 3 weeks advance notice to Facilities team
- The Facilities team needs this lead time for AV setup, security coordination, and catering arrangements
- C-suite attendance is MANDATORY for company all-hands meetings
- CEO and at least 2 other C-level executives must confirm attendance before event date is finalized

### Venue Requirements
- Company all-hands require Auditorium A (capacity 500) or equivalent external venue
- If Auditorium A is unavailable, external venue booking requires VP-level approval and adds $5K-$10K to budget

### Budget Guidelines
- Standard all-hands budget: $25K-$35K (venue + catering + AV)
- Budget must be approved by Finance Director minimum 2 weeks before event
- Any amount exceeding $30K requires CFO sign-off
- Catering: plan for $22-$25 per person for full-day events

### Catering
- Orders must be placed minimum 5 business days in advance
- Dietary accommodations survey must be sent 2 weeks prior
- Standard menu: breakfast, lunch, 2 snack breaks, beverages throughout

### Communication
- Save-the-date notification: 4 weeks before event
- Detailed agenda: 1 week before event
- Post-event survey: within 2 business days after

## Conflict Resolution
- Board meetings take absolute priority over all other bookings
- Product launches can be rescheduled if they conflict with all-hands (requires VP Product approval)
- Recurring meetings should be cancelled for the all-hands day with 1 week notice

## Remote Participation
- All company events must have live streaming capability
- Recording must be available within 24 hours for remote employees
- Time zones: optimize for majority attendance (US Pacific primary, provide APAC/EMEA replay)

title: Auditorium A - Booking & Capacity Information
content:
# Auditorium A

## Specifications
- Maximum capacity: 500 (theater style), 300 (classroom style)
- Built-in AV: projector, screen, basic sound system
- Advanced AV (stage lighting, multi-camera streaming): requires TechStage Productions booking
- Location: HQ Building, Ground Floor

## Booking Rules
- Book through Scheduler system (scheduler_create_job or contact Facilities)
- Maximum single booking: full day (09:00-17:00)
- Cannot be split into multiple events on the same day
- Priority: Board meetings > Company all-hands > Product launches > Department events

## Current Known Bookings (June-July 2026)

- June 25: Auditorium tentatively held for all-hands Q2 (full day) - CONFLICT with above
- July 2: Town Hall (tentative hold)

## Availability Notes

- June 26 (Thursday) or June 30 (Monday) are available alternatives
- July 2 tentative hold can be released with 1-week notice
